successor_of: EXP-0041-scratch-helper-abi (valid, non-quarantined negative boundary evidence); EXP-0057-m4-scratch-pressure-envelope is QUARANTINED and is NOT a predecessor -- no file, artifact, or numeric result from it is reused, cited, or copied here. This is a fresh pre-registration per its QUARANTINE.md's own requirement.
target: local Apple M4 / G16G only (per CLAUDE.md target discipline; A18 Pro is hands-off)
frozen_revision_note: Recorded at pre-registration time for provenance only. Per the dispatch brief ('pin the revision and do NOT gate on live HEAD') and the EXP-0082 precedent cited in experiments/SUBAGENT_BRIEF.md, this value is NEVER used as a live blocking check -- the orchestrator commits sibling experiments' work while this one runs, so repo HEAD moving is expected and is not contamination. Captures are gated on the authored EXP-0107 file hashes recorded in each run's own 00_inputs.json, compared to each other (run01 vs run02), never to this frozen revision or to live HEAD.
run_id_policy: append-only; a run id is used at most once ever; a partial/killed run directory is retained as-is and never topped up, repaired, or reused -- a replacement (if ever needed) takes a new experiment number per SUBAGENT_BRIEF.md, not a new run id here.
case_matrix_source_of_truth: casematrix.py (ALL_CASES, CASE_KEYS, TIMING_KEYS, escalation policy) -- this contract does not restate the matrix, only the design constraints it must satisfy

case_matrix_design_constraints.K_purpose: CS register/array-pressure ladder (own array-loop MSL kernels, n=1), K=8..49152 plus the compile-time boundary pair the pre-registration reconnaissance located (last known-good / first known-fail), reproducing the boundary as gated evidence rather than asserting the reconnaissance number
case_matrix_design_constraints.S_purpose: stage variation (VS, FS) at a subset of K's own pressure levels
case_matrix_design_constraints.O_purpose: occupancy/topology ladder at one fixed clearly-spilling K, total dispatched threads from 1,024 to 4,194,304 and threadgroup shape 32/256/1024
case_matrix_design_constraints.X_purpose: compound stress: high per-thread declared scratch together with the largest tested total thread count
case_matrix_design_constraints.H_purpose: genuine repeated spill/fill traffic (n>1 runtime pass count), not only the n=1 degenerate init+reduce correctness check
case_matrix_design_constraints.one_variable_per_case: within each family, exactly one of {K, stage, grid, tg, n} differs from that family's own reference case
case_matrix_design_constraints.escalation_policy: families K/O/X (ascending risk order) stop -- later entries recorded executed=false, never invoked -- after the first entry whose probe status is not OK; K gets exactly one grace case past its first non-OK entry to capture the immediate post-boundary point; a TIMEOUT or unhandled exception in ANY case, ANY family, aborts the entire remaining run immediately

clean_room_boundary.category: OWN-SHADER (compiled MSL we authored) + DATA-TRACE (our own process's IOKit boundary traffic, incl. BO content) + PUBLIC (Metal API surface only)
clean_room_boundary.compile_path: harness/probe.m (runtime newLibraryWithSource:, public Metal API) for live execution; tools/shdump/shdump.m (read-only, our own tool) via harness/metadata.py for archive metadata extraction -- the established, non-quarantined EXP-0041/EXP-0020 pattern
clean_room_boundary.metadata_extraction: harness/metadata.py walks the archive's OWN AppleGPU Mach-O image(s) via tools/shdump/agxparse.py (read-only) to reach the __GPU_METADATA FlatBuffer for the just-compiled stage(s); reads the two established numeric fields (GPR footprint field 0, scratch field 41/14) plus every other top-level u32 field reachable by the identical parse; optionally retains only _agc.main bytes compiled from this experiment's own authored source
clean_room_boundary.boundary_trace: harness/maptrace.c, a DYLD interposer over the public IOKit user-client surface (IOServiceOpen/IOConnectCallMethod), logging selector + scalar/struct data for our own process only
clean_room_boundary.widened_capability_vs_EXP-0041: EXP-0041 read the CONTENT of only four pre-established command/state BOs and left all other mapped BOs' bytes unread. Because this experiment's task is explicitly to locate a scratch BO if one exists, it additionally reads a bounded prefix (env MAPTRACE_PREFIX_CAP, default 16384 B) of EVERY BO our own process registers via the resource-map selector. This is still DATA-TRACE: every byte is our own process's own memory that our own process itself registered into the GPU address space; no pointer found inside a mapped BO is ever followed to open a further object; no Apple binary, framework, kext, or firmware is opened, disassembled, or introspected.
clean_room_boundary.gpu_addresses_excluded_from_gated_payloa: CASE_KEYS (casematrix.py) contains no raw GPU virtual address field. Resource-map comparison across cases/runs uses `resource_map_shape` (an address-free (class,size)->count multiset) and `bo_content_seq_sha256` (content hashed in first-seen/call order, never by address). Raw VAs are retained only in the ungated `05_raw_maps.jsonl` and the maptrace .log/.hex files, for analysis use, never for the cross-run byte-gate.
clean_room_boundary.forbidden: no disassembly/decompilation/introspection of any Apple binary; no leaked/unreleased/NDA material; no code copied from Apple or incompatibly-licensed sources

standing_gates_implemented: verify.py --selftest (synthetic fixtures from recorded reality; injected-defect rejection)
run.py NON-RECORDED smoke gate before any raw/ artifact is created
no nondeterministic field in the gated payload (CASE_KEYS/TIMING_KEYS separation, enforced by exact key-set comparison)
fixtures FROM RECORDED REALITY (selftest fixtures are built from the real casematrix.ALL_CASES, not invented data)
other_directives: append + fflush(+fsync) each JSONL record as its case completes
PROGRESS.md gets one line per completed/skipped case and per run milestone
partial RESULTS.md sections are written as soon as their data exists
one variable per case within a family
faults are results (a clean STATUS-reported failure is recorded and, within its family's escalation policy, does not itself stop the run; only a TIMEOUT or unhandled exception stops the run)
a run id is never reused
no post-capture repair of a raw/ artifact
tools/ is read-only (tools/shdump only, invoked as a subprocess/import; nothing under tools/ is modified)
nothing is written outside this experiment's own directory; no git commit is made by this agent
